title: C++: State Machine
description: Implement a finite state machine for a vending machine.

steps.title: Vending Machine FSM
steps.description: Define states: IDLE, SELECTING, DISPENSING. Track the current state and handle events: insertCoin, selectItem, dispense. Transitions: IDLE -> SELECTING (coin), SELECTING -> DISPENSING (item selected), DISPENSING -> IDLE (dispensed). Print state changes.
hints: enum class State { IDLE, SELECTING, DISPENSING };
Each event checks current state and transitions to next.
Use a switch statement or function table.
